description: Part-load efficiency + altitude correction + ambient temperature derating

unit.name: Generic 1 MW Lean-Burn Natural Gas Engine Genset
unit.source: US EPA CHP Catalog (2017) Section 2: Reciprocating Engines; Jenbacher J320/J420 product data; Caterpillar G3500 series; ISO 3046-1:2002

P_el_rated_kw.note: Rated electrical output at 25 degC, sea level

LHV_gas_mjkg.note: Lower heating value of natural gas

rho_gas_kgm3.note: Density of natural gas at STP

temp_derating_pct_per_degC.note: Power derating per degC above T_ref; reciprocating engines less sensitive than turbines

altitude_derating_pct_per_100m.note: Power derating per 100m altitude above sea level (ISO 3046-1 ~1%/100m for turbocharged engines)
